title: Horizontal branch connections above or below vertical stack offsets.
officialText: If a horizontal branch connects to the stack within 2 feet (610 mm) above or below a vertical stack offset, and the offset is located more than four branch intervals below the top of the stack, the offset shall be vented in accordance with Section PC 915.
